column8: ["Give the broad purple bridge more ceramic character with pooled glaze, subtle surface variation, and a few sharper reflected highlights.","Separate the brass crescent from its dark backing with clearer edge highlights and richer tarnish; its fittings currently merge into a muddy band.","Make the seat liners feel more like worn rubber through distinct matte surfaces, compressed edges, and selective scuffing."]

["Give the central brass junction clearer planes and sharper edge glints; its muddy transitions weaken the machine’s weight.","Differentiate the materials more strongly: crisp reflections on purple glaze, broken highlights on tarnished brass, and matte, compressed rubber around the seats.","Add distinctive construction details—fasteners, fitted collars, and small chips exposing ceramic—to make the broad purple shoulders feel crafted and reward close inspection."]

["Give the central brass junction clearer overlapping plates, fasteners and rubbed edges so its construction feels deliberate.","Differentiate the purple glaze from the dark rubber with sharper pooled highlights on ceramic and flatter, worn contact surfaces on rubber.","Enrich the seat rims with distinct bevels, recessed shadows and small asymmetric wear marks to make the openings feel deeper and more tangible."]
